Background / Context

The project involves developing a content management system (CMS) tailored for Ruby on Rails developers. Refinery CMS is designed to create customizable and content-manageable websites efficiently by adhering to "The Rails Way." It is well-suited for developers familiar with Ruby on Rails and aims to streamline the development process.

Objectives

- Provide an intuitive CMS for building and managing websites.
- Simplify content creation and management with visual tools.
- Support easy customization through extensions and plugins.
- Facilitate secure user authentication and role management.
- Enable seamless integration of media files and resources.

Stakeholders & Users

- Developers: Primarily Ruby on Rails developers who will implement and customize websites using Refinery CMS.
- Administrators: Users responsible for managing website content, structure, and user access.
- End-users: Individuals who will interact with the front-end of websites built on Refinery CMS.

Functional Descriptions

1. Page Management: 
   - Edit and organize pages using a visual editor.
   - Manage site structure and navigation.

2. Media Management:
   - Upload and insert images seamlessly using Dragonfly.
   - Store media on Amazon S3 for scalability.
   - Manage and link to various resources such as PDF documents.

3. User Authentication & Roles:
   - Manage user access and roles using Devise.
   - Define permissions for extensions and functionalities per user.

4. Extension Support:
   - Generate custom extensions using the Refinery extension generator.
   - Popular extensions include:
     - Blog: Manage posts, categories, and comments.
     - Portfolio: Create image galleries.
     - News: Post and manage news items.
     - Inquiries: Handle contact form submissions and notifications.

Non-Functional Descriptions

- Ease of Use: Designed to be approachable for Ruby on Rails developers, leveraging Rails conventions.
- Scalability: Supports scalable media storage with Amazon S3 integration.
- Security: Secure authentication and role management using industry-standard practices (Devise).
- Extensibility: Easily extensible through generators and available plugins.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0006
CREATE TABLE `refinery_authentication_devise_roles` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_authentication_devise_users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `encrypted_password` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_sign_in_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_sign_in_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_sign_in_ip` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_sign_in_ip` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sign_in_count` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `remember_created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `reset_password_token` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reset_password_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_authentication_devise_roles_users` (
  `role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`role_id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_authentication_devise_roles_users_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_authentication_devise_roles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_authentication_devise_roles_users_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_authentication_devise_users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_authentication_devise_user_plugins` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_authentication_devise_user_plugins_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_authentication_devise_users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_images` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `image_mime_type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_size` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_width` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_height` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_uid` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_image_translations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `refinery_image_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_alt` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_image_translations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`refinery_image_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_images` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_pages` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `parent_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `show_in_menu` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `link_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `menu_match` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deletable` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `draft` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skip_to_first_child` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lft` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rgt` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `depth` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `view_template` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `layout_template` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `children_count` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_pages_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_page_parts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `refinery_page_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_page_parts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`refinery_page_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_page_part_translations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `refinery_page_part_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_page_part_translations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`refinery_page_part_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_page_parts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_page_translations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `refinery_page_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `custom_slug` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `menu_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_page_translations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`refinery_page_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_resources` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `file_mime_type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_size` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_uid` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_ext` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `refinery_resource_translations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `resource_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `refinery_resource_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `refinery_resource_translations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`refinery_resource_id`) REFERENCES `refinery_resources` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
